title: Atelier SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Upstream DSH fields (name, description, whenToUse, metadata, disable-model-invocation, user-invocable) plus Atelier extensions under metadata.atelier. A skill with no metadata.atelier is a plain instruction skill and still works.

description.description: One line; this is the catalogue entry every turn, so keep it under ~25 tokens.

profiles.description: Profiles whose catalogue lists this skill; omitted = every profile that mounts the skills root.

mode.description: schema: reveal the listed tool schemas (appended at the end of the tool list, once). proxy: no tool-list change; the model calls skill_call(skill, tool, args).

tools.description: Tool names or prefixes (name*) revealed when the skill is active. Tools listed by no skill are always visible.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive regex; a match in the user's latest request pre-activates the skill before step 1.

preactivate.description: One YES/NO question for the fast System 1 router. Asked only when keywords did not decide and the message is not content-free.

pin.description: Pin the body as a harness message; re-pin after compaction.

budget_tokens.description: Ceiling for body + revealed schemas; the loader warns in the log above it and refuses above 2x.

references.description: Files under the skill folder readable with skill_read(name, file); never loaded automatically.

requires.description: Skills activated together with this one.

trust.description: unreviewed skills are never listed in a catalogue.

legacy_group.description: Migration only: the lean-surface group id this skill replaces; the generator must produce the same group bytes.
